title: Gap and Go
summary: Of the sessions that gapped in the chosen direction, how often the gap NEVER filled AND the session closed beyond its own open in the gap's direction: the continuation measured directly, not inferred as the complement of the fill rate. A session that merely avoided the fill but faded back through its open does not count as a go; this is the stricter, honest definition. Roll days are excluded by construction.

params.name: minGapPct
params.doc: Only gaps at least this large (percent of prior close, absolute).

deltas: a real outcome, not the mirrored fill rate: no-fill AND directional close are both required, so a stalled gap can't masquerade as a go
grouped by gap size out of the box: the go rate is famously size-dependent, and the per-bucket N shows exactly where the sample thins out
a size floor turns 'gap and go' into a testable definition instead of a slogan
N + 95% CI + stability split on every number
